description: This file contains functions for parsing, forging, comparing, and managing LLDP payload structures in a network protocol implementation. It specifically deals with LLDP TLVs within IEEE 1905.1/1a stacks, including parsing from packets, serialization, and validation of mandatory TLVs.

methods.name: i1905_lldp_payload_t * parse_lldp_PAYLOAD_from_packet(uint8_t * packet_stream)
methods.description: Parses a raw packet stream to extract and validate an LLDP payload structure, checking for required TLVs like chassis ID, port ID, and TTL.

methods.name: uint8_t * forge_lldp_PAYLOAD_from_structure(i1905_lldp_payload_t * memory_structure,uint16_t * len)
methods.description: Serializes an LLDP payload structure into a byte stream suitable for network transmission, including mandatory TLVs and end of LLDP PDU.

methods.name: void free_lldp_PAYLOAD_structure(i1905_lldp_payload_t * memory_structure)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for an LLDP payload structure and its contained TLVs.

methods.name: uint8_t compare_lldp_PAYLOAD_structures(i1905_lldp_payload_t * memory_structure_1,i1905_lldp_payload_t * memory_structure_2)
methods.description: Compares two LLDP payload structures for equality based on their TLV contents.

methods.name: void visit_lldp_PAYLOAD_structure(i1905_lldp_payload_t * memory_structure,void (* callback)(void (* write_function)(const char * fmt,...),const char * prefix,size_t size,const char * name,const char * fmt,void * p),void (* write_function)(const char * fmt,...),const char * prefix)
methods.description: Traverses the LLDP payload structure, invoking callback functions to process or display each TLV, appending TLV type info to a prefix string.
